publicSeams.description: Platform integration entry point for organization legal profile routes and behavior.
Service contract for organization legal profile lifecycle and export projection operations.

dependsOn.description: Legal profiles resolve and authorize their owning organization through the organizationCore public service seam.
Tenant-admin legal profile routes require an active tenant session context.

breakingChangeRisks: Changing one-active legal profile semantics can break Organization export, search, and admin detail slices.
Changing legal-profile route context behavior can break root and tenant scoped child-resource consumers.
